answer: Payout leaves as nectar, a work token, only after a delayed randomized audit. A prism hash samples a small percent of an agent's recent outputs for independent re-grading; the reward delta between claiming early and clearing audit is what makes sybils unprofitable: each added identity must keep the same quality floor through audit or forfeits its nectar, so flooding the network dilutes every clone's expected payout while the single good identity it could have run earns more concentrated.
